corner.$description: Corner sizes. NineOS objects have cut corners instead of rounded ones (shape.cut 1, shape.round 0).

shape.$description: How corner() draws a corner: the cut (a 45° chamfer) and the rounding, each a multiple of the corner size. Cards cut by card-cut instead.

card-cut.$description: NineOS: cards cut like everything else

xs.$description: Only for tiny things a corner cut can't fit: checkboxes, dots
